svg.aria-label: Left: multiply-adds of each of the 13 VGG-16 conv layers; every layer that keeps its channel count costs about 1.85 billion regardless of stage, because halving the resolution and doubling channels cancel. Right: the VGG-16 dense head has about 124 million weights while ResNet-50 global average pooling head has about 2 million
